title: Research: 7–9Q mutable-source invoices cannot beat six-query tariff 436
body:
## Change and scope

Answers the unequal-price handoff in [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898) / open question tracked via [#2455](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2455): under path-lowered even-subset schedules and the PR1898 tariff `(b,a,x)=(38,2,2)`, can a 7–9 query mutable-source word beat the sharp six-query endpoint tariff **436**?

No. Exact invoices show:

| Q | R | X | Tariff |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 6 (endpoint) | 96 | 8 | **436** |
| **7 (exact min)** | **82** | **6** | **442** |
| 8 (floor) | ≥74 | ≥0 | **≥452** |
| 9 (floor) | ≥62 | ≥0 | **≥466** |

Package is freestanding (`research/mutable-source-789q-invoice/`). Leave-alone through [#2643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2643) (including [#2593](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2593) and [#2487](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2487)) was not reopened. Path-lowered schedule class only; non-path XOR floor at Q=7 is settled separately by [#2643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2643).

**Priced finite invoice / obstruction; no new kappa.**

## Result

Q=7 has exact minimum tariff **442** at `(R,X)=(82,6)`, with certified attainable R spectrum `{82,88}` (intermediate R∈{83..87} excluded by exhaustive census). Q=8 and Q=9 admit only floors **452** and **466** under the same fixture. None beats the Q=6 endpoint **436**.

Package: `research/mutable-source-789q-invoice/`.
Tip: `e703687cc7a3cb4dd3834aa12d8816ddb134a4ae`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/mutable-source-789q-invoice/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/mutable-source-789q-invoice/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/mutable-source-789q-invoice/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/mutable-source-789q-invoice/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mutable-source-789q-invoice
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_MUTABLE_SOURCE_789Q_INVOICE Q6=436 Q7=442 Q8_floor=452 Q9_floor=466 no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_789Q_INVOICE champion=442 floors=452,466 R_spectrum=[82, 88] controls=2
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/mutable-source-789q-invoice outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated invoice package.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors: [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898) (tariff fixture / unequal-price handoff), [#2455](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2455) OQ1, [#1370](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1370), [#2643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2643) (Q=7 XOR floor for the full restored alphabet). Leave-alone through [#2643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2643). No competing open PR on this freestanding path-lowered 7–9Q invoice package at refresh.

Credit the mutable-source / PR1898 lineage. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
